item.title: Civic Meetup #556: Lessons Learned from a Cyber Attack: Toronto Public Library’s Experience - by Civic Tech Toronto — Tue Aug 18, 7:00 PM — available upon registration
item.description:
More info: https://guild.host/events/civic-meetup-556-lessons-ctlgvm
Hosted by Civic Tech Toronto (https://civictech.ca/)
In 2023, Toronto Public Library shut down every network and computer system wide after discovering a cyberattack, meanwhile all 100 branches remained open anyway. This session walks through the incident response governance, the phased restoration of a 5,000+ computer environment, and the lessons TPL learned the hard way.
Source: Show Up Toronto

item.title: SALSA Tuesdays at Cobble Fish — Tue Aug 18, 7:00 PM — Cobble Fish
item.description:
DJ John John presents SALSA Tuesdays at Cobble Fish * Pier 16 * South Street Seaport * NYC * OUTDOOR EVENT each and every Tuesday | No Cover
Hola mi gente, WE’RE BACK! SALSA Tuesdays by Pier 16 at Cobble Fish” located at the South Street Seaport each and every Tuesday from 7:00 pm to 11:00 with NO COVER CHARGE starting CINCO DE MAYO. What’s a summer in NYC without dancing outdoors to your favorite salsa tunes overlooking the beautiful Brooklyn skyline as you enjoy some delicious refreshments and food from the iconic Cobble Fish restaurant located at 89 South Street at Pier 16. This is a FREE OUTDOOR EVENT/NO COVER, with that said, this is also a restaurant/venue hosting this event and they do expect and encourage customers to consume. To assure they do there will be a suggested 2 Drink minimum or 1 Food item requirement when seating. Let’s spread the word and enjoy the great weather while we have it. Date: Each and every Tuesday (STARTING CINCO DE MAYO) Time: 7:00 pm to 11:00

item.title: Reading Rhythms Toronto: August 24th — Mon Aug 24, 7:00 PM — Squirly's
item.description:
Address: Squirly's Toronto, ON Canada
You’re invited! Reading Rhythms is a series of welcoming reading parties designed to make it easy for people to gather and read socially. We invite you to bring any book you want and facilitate silent reading periods, as well as 1-on-1 breakouts, and group discussions to pull on the threads of the books that everyone is engaging with. In a world that can often feel devoid of interest and meaningful connection, we bring readers together to reconnect with our love of learning, to experience the wonder of beautiful venues and curated music, and to gather amongst all of the people who want to be…
Hosted by Reading Rhythms, Aashna Aggarwal & Janice Prazoff
Source: Luma Toronto Discover
